description: This file defines the UserViewHelper class which handles UI logic, preferences, and view setups for user profile editing and detail pages within the SuiteCRM system. It manages user types, permissions, themes, locale, email settings, and other user-specific configurations.

classes.name: UserViewHelper
classes.description: A helper class managing user profile views, preferences, themes, locale, and permissions within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the helper with Smarty template object, user bean, and view type.

methods.name: setupAdditionalFields
methods.description: Populates the Smarty object with user-related settings and UI components.

methods.name: assignUserTypes
methods.description: Determines and assigns user type-related flags and permissions.

methods.name: setupButtonsAndTabs
methods.description: Configures UI buttons and navigation tabs for the user profile page.

methods.name: setupUserTypeDropdown
methods.description: Prepares the user type dropdown menu based on permissions and current user context.

methods.name: setupPasswordTab
methods.description: Configures password-related UI elements and restrictions.

methods.name: setupThemeTab
methods.description: Sets theme options and favorites for the user profile.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTab
methods.description: Organizes the advanced settings tab including locale, team, and module preferences.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabUserSettings
methods.description: Prepares user-specific locale and notification preferences.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabTeamSettings
methods.description: Handles external authentication and LDAP settings for the user.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabNavSettings
methods.description: Configures navigation and module display preferences.

methods.name: setupAdvancedTabLocaleSettings
methods.description: Sets date/time formats, timezone, currency, and number formatting options.

methods.name: setupEmailSettings
methods.description: Prepares email sending options and external SMTP configurations.

methods.name: setUserType
methods.description: Determines and assigns the user type of a given user instance.
